The '''Wreyn-Tsatke Cyber-Psychology Scale''' was a diagnostic testing scale applied to [[Droid/Legends|droid]] personalities by [[Psychologist/Legends|psychologists]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Scores on the test were composed of a number between 1 and 10 signifying the subject's intelligence rating, followed by three letters with various meanings. [[Mentor]],<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Intelligence Profile: SCORPIO}}</ref> a droid consciousness that attempted to lead a [[Directive 7|droid revolution]],<ref name="Mentor">{{TORcite|type=codex|Mentor}}</ref> scored a 10-NCM on the scale and the droid [[G0-T9]] received a 8-HSM rating. An application of the test on the droid [[SCORPIO]] resulted in a 9-NIX rating&mdash;level 9 intelligence, non-[[Human/Legends|Human]], independent, unknown&mdash;with an accuracy rating of 22%. The score signified similarities to Mentor and G0-T9, and the results matched anecdotal experiences: SCORPIO did not consider any biological or cybernetic lifeform to be of interest or value, and was primarily interested in evolving herself. She valued others who shared her traits, such as intelligence, curiosity, and amoral self-interest.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wreyn-Tsatke Scale was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the droid SCORPIO in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], though the significance of some of the rating components was not explained.<ref name="Codex" />
